build_sigloss_for_depth: build a SigLoss module with warm-up to compute scale-invariant log loss for monocular depth estimation
create_multiloss_combination: create a MultiLoss module combining SigLoss and GradientLoss with custom weights for depth training
use_gradientloss_multiscale: use GradientLoss to compute multi-scale gradient differences between predicted and ground truth depth maps
use_gradientlogloss_multiscale: use GradientLogLoss to compute multi-scale gradient differences on log-transformed depth predictions and targets
use_l1loss_masked: use L1Loss to compute masked L1 error between predicted and ground truth depth tensors
